_doc: Cameras in plan cm (x east, y south, z up), house type 5 ground floor, floor 0.
exterior: ground floor at garden level: through the glass a landscaped garden in golden-hour light - a warm stone terrace right outside, lawn, a clipped hedge, olive trees, soft green hills far away under a warm golden sky with a few soft clouds. Never sea, never city, never night.
time_of_day: golden hour, about 18:30 in late spring - low warm sun from the south-west streams in through the glass, long soft honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls, warm glowing air; bright, warm and inviting - never night

fittings._head: Light fittings: ONLY these, exactly as modelled in IMAGE 1:
fittings.pendant_bronze: the two long thin bronze bars hanging on very long cables from the high ceiling over the dining table are slim linear bronze pendants
fittings.pendant_black_linear: the slim black bar hanging on cables over the island is a linear black pendant
fittings.pendant_alabaster: the two small ivory cylinders hanging on cables beside the bed are alabaster pendants glowing softly
fittings.onyx_backlit: the amber-gold panel behind the headboard is backlit honey onyx glowing warm
fittings.walnut_fluted: the short white lines under the stair treads are warm step lights
fittings.mirror_backlit: the mirror glows softly from behind
fittings.mirror_bronze: the white vertical line beside the bronze mirror is a slim warm LED bar
fittings.walnut_slats: the white ring in the spa ceiling is a circular warm LED cove
fittings.ceiling_walnut_garage: the white lines in the garage ceiling are recessed linear LED lights
fittings.led_line: a pure-white line along the edge of a ceiling is a warm 2700K cove light, a white line under a shelf, vanity or bench is a warm under-glow
fittings._none: Light fittings: none in this view - golden-hour daylight only.
fittings._tail: Add NO other light of any kind: no spotlights, no downlights, no track lights, no recessed ceiling lights, no extra LED strips, no wall lights, no chandeliers, no glowing outlines along edges. The thin GREY guide lines are not lights.
fittings._decor: Decor: only the modelled objects - an olive tree and fiddle-leaf figs in stone pots (green sphere on a trunk), dried pampas (beige stems), slim olive branches in small vases, large abstract paintings in frames, books, lemons, rugs, cushions, sheer linen curtains, towels, a candle; add no new objects.

names.counter: straight kitchen base-cabinet run with sink

cameras.title: Living - frontal north view: fluted walnut wall, floating stair, the high ceiling
cameras.notes: Straight-on frontal view of the full-height fluted smoked-walnut wall with the floating walnut stair and its raked glass balustrade; the wall rises the full 5.6 m and its top edge meets the ceiling in one perfectly horizontal line. The living + dining ceiling is completely FLAT and horizontal at 5.60 m - a plain warm-white plaster plane; every wall and the glass meet it in a crisp straight 90-degree corner. Never sloped, pitched, vaulted, angled or stepped. On the left the kitchen sits under its LOWER 2.8 m pale-oak ceiling; the step from 2.8 m to 5.6 m is one clean vertical wall face above the dining with a large abstract painting on it. Through the glass: golden-hour garden - a warm stone terrace, lawn, a clipped hedge, olive trees, soft hills under a warm golden sky; low sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Living - frontal west view across sofa and dining to the painting and the kitchen
cameras.notes: Frontal west view. The tall wall above the kitchen (from 2.8 m up to 5.6 m) carries one monumental abstract painting; below it the kitchen opens under its lower pale-oak ceiling. The living + dining ceiling is completely FLAT and horizontal at 5.60 m - a plain warm-white plaster plane; every wall and the glass meet it in a crisp straight 90-degree corner. Never sloped, pitched, vaulted, angled or stepped. On the right the full-height glass to the south terrace. Through the glass: golden-hour garden - a warm stone terrace, lawn, a clipped hedge, olive trees, soft hills under a warm golden sky; low sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Kitchen + dining - frontal west view from beside the sofa
cameras.notes: The dining table for 6 under the high ceiling in front, then the marble island and the black-oak kitchen under the lower 2.8 m pale-oak ceiling. The edge where the low ceiling meets the high space is one straight horizontal line. Through the glass: golden-hour garden - a warm stone terrace, lawn, a clipped hedge, olive trees, soft hills under a warm golden sky; low sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Entrance hall - from the front door toward the kitchen and living
cameras.notes: Entrance hall: the reeded walnut wardrobe runs along the left wall, a painting on the right wall; ahead the kitchen and the bright high living space with golden-hour light.

cameras.title: Bedroom - frontal view of the bed wall
cameras.notes: Frontal view of the bed wall: vertical smoked-walnut slats across the whole wall, centred behind the bed a tall backlit honey-onyx panel glowing warm gold with an ivory channel headboard in front of it, two alabaster pendants. The room is dark and moody - deep taupe walls, dark walnut floor - with bright ivory and gold details.

cameras.title: Bedroom - toward the sliding glass and the garden
cameras.notes: Sliding glass door to the garden at golden hour; low sun lays long warm patches across the dark walnut floor; the bed on the left. Through the glass: golden-hour garden - a warm stone terrace, lawn, a clipped hedge, olive trees, soft hills under a warm golden sky; low sun streaming in.

cameras.title: Ensuite - from the door
cameras.notes: This ensuite is 70 % DARK: near-black Nero Marquina marble walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; ONLY the shower back wall is warm cream caramel-veined marble (the light detail). Ambient, intimate light from the ceiling cove, the backlit mirror and under the vanity - moody and luxurious, not bright. No window.

cameras.title: Bath - from the door
cameras.notes: This bath is 70 % DARK: dark charcoal chevron stone walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; light details: a floating white-grey Carrara marble vanity slab and a bronze mirror with a slim LED bar. One small window high in the north wall with a little warm evening light.

cameras.title: Spa - frontal north view: shower, plant, moss wall, jacuzzi, garden glass
cameras.notes: Frontal north view of the spa exactly as in the plan: the walk-in shower behind its clear glass screen in the back-LEFT corner, a tall bird-of-paradise plant in a stone planter next to it, a living moss wall behind the round basalt jacuzzi, the floor-to-ceiling sliding glass to the garden on the right. Dark basalt walls, dark stone floor, dark smoked-walnut slat ceiling with a circular warm cove above the jacuzzi.

cameras.title: Spa - from the garden glass toward the sauna and shower
cameras.notes: The sauna is a LARGE walk-in walnut room (1.5 m wide, 2.2 m deep): its front is a smoked-walnut panel plus a bronze-glass wall with a glass door, and its side has a bronze-glass panel; through the glass the dark thermo-walnut interior with two long bench levels runs deep back. The walk-in shower behind clear glass to its right, the round basalt jacuzzi in front right. Two calm abstract paintings hang on the long basalt wall on the left.

cameras.title: Garage - front three-quarter view of the G-Wagon
cameras.notes: A MATTE BLACK Mercedes-AMG G 63 (G-Wagon) parked nose-in toward the camera side: satin matte black paint (not glossy), round LED headlights, black wheels. Garage gallery: dark stone floor, charcoal walls, the far wall in vertical smoked-walnut slats with an LED line at the top, dark walnut slat ceiling with linear LED lines. Sectional garage door closed.

cameras.title: Garage - rear three-quarter view of the G-Wagon
cameras.notes: A MATTE BLACK Mercedes-AMG G 63 (G-Wagon) seen from the rear three-quarter: boxy body, spare wheel on the tailgate, satin matte black paint (not glossy). Dark walnut slat ceiling with linear LED lines, charcoal walls, dark stone floor.
